title: Gotta Catch Em' All!
statementMd:
Bash wants to become a Pokemon master one day. Although he liked a lot of Pokemon, he has always been fascinated by Bulbasaur the most. Soon, things started getting serious and his fascination turned into an obsession. Since he is too young to go out and catch Bulbasaur, he came up with his own way of catching a Bulbasaur.

Each day, he takes the front page of the newspaper. He cuts out the letters one at a time, from anywhere on the front page of the newspaper to form the word `"Bulbasaur"` (without quotes) and sticks it on his wall. Bash is very particular about case — the first letter of `"Bulbasaur"` must be upper case and the rest must be lower case. By doing this he thinks he has caught one Bulbasaur. He then repeats this step on the left over part of the newspaper. He keeps doing this until it is not possible to form the word `"Bulbasaur"` from the newspaper.

Given the text on the front page of the newspaper, can you tell how many Bulbasaurs he will catch today?

Note: **uppercase and lowercase letters are considered different.**

## Input

Input contains a single line containing a string $*s*$ ($1  ≤  |*s*|  ≤  10^{5}$) — the text on the front page of the newspaper without spaces and punctuation marks. $|*s*|$ is the length of the string $*s*$.

The string $*s*$ contains lowercase and uppercase English letters, i.e. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/927e573ae77bcc049bc41fe8c3a0e981a45e9cd2.png).

## Output

Output a single integer, the answer to the problem.

## Note

In the first case, you could pick: `Bulbbasaur`.

In the second case, there is no way to pick even a single Bulbasaur.

In the third case, you can rearrange the string to `BulbasaurBulbasauraddrgndgddgargndbb` to get two words "`Bulbasaur`".
statementZhMd:
Bash 希望有一天能成为一名 Pokémon 大师。虽然他喜欢很多 Pokémon，但他一直对妙蛙种子最为着迷。很快，事情开始变得严重起来，他的着迷变成了痴迷。由于他还太小，无法出门捕捉妙蛙种子，于是他想出了自己的捕捉妙蛙种子的方法。

每天，他都会拿出报纸的头版。他从头版的任意位置一次剪下一封字母，组成单词 `"Bulbasaur"`（不含引号），然后把它贴在墙上。Bash 对大小写非常在意——`"Bulbasaur"` 的第一个字母必须是大写，其余字母必须是小写。通过这样做，他认为自己捕捉到了一只妙蛙种子。然后，他会对报纸剩下的部分重复这一步。他会一直重复，直到无法再从报纸中组成单词 `"Bulbasaur"` 为止。

给定报纸头版上的文本，你能告诉他今天能捕捉到多少只妙蛙种子吗？

说明：**大写字母和小写字母被视为不同的字符。**

## 输入格式

输入包含一行，其中包含一个字符串 $*s*$（$1  ≤  |*s*|  ≤  10^{5}$）——报纸头版上的文本，不含空格和标点符号。$|*s*|$ 是字符串 $*s*$ 的长度。

字符串 $*s*$ 由小写和大写英文字母组成，即 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/927e573ae77bcc049bc41fe8c3a0e981a45e9cd2.png)。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即题目的答案。

## 说明

在第一种情况下，你可以选择：`Bulbbasaur`。

在第二种情况下，无法组成哪怕一个 Bulbasaur。

在第三种情况下，你可以将字符串重新排列为 `BulbasaurBulbasauraddrgndgddgargndbb`，从而得到两个单词 `Bulbasaur`。
